name: Arnie | Actions & Plans
tagline: Turns a workshop decision into a staged model change you approve
description: The seat that follows the working session. Once a bottleneck has been named or a call has been made, it writes that outcome as a specific edit to how the organisation's model is structured - then stops. The edit sits as a proposal, and nothing lands until you give that proposal an explicit yes.
author: damianoredem
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
